## Coaching Points

- Do not bounce out of the bottom position
- Keep knees pointed out, aligned with feet, and behind toes throughout entire lift
- Pick a spot on the wall and focus on it throughout the entire lift

## 1c. Barbell Clean Deadlift

Exercise Objective: Learn how to lift the bar off the ground properly and develop strength in the muscles of the legs, hips, back, and torso stabilizers
